name: olai-plugin-xyne-spaces
//name: UNSCOPED, for `olai-plugin-kolu`'s reason: `@olai/*` is the scope for the packages that ARE olai, and a tenant is named the way a plugin written outside this tree would be. The directory is now `xyne-spaces`; the package name stays `olai-plugin-xyne-spaces`.
//exports: SIX entries, and three of them are DISJOINT graphs — it is `olai-plugin-odu`'s manifest one appliance over, deliberately the same shape. `./wire` is the declaration everything that composes or reads the surface pulls in statically. `./browser` is what REPLACED the manifest: a Cordis plugin (`name`, `inject`, `apply`) registering the spaces pill and the tab's one subscription into the app's declared slots. It carries SolidJS and it is a CHUNK, fetched only when the roster names this plugin — which for an OPT-IN row (`disabled: true` in `olai.yml`) means usually by nobody at all. The ROOT is the wire identity and nothing more, now that there is no manifest for it to be. `./server` is the runtime half, its own door so a process that renders nothing must not pull a UI runtime. `./testids` is NAMES ONLY. `./all.css` is the sheet, a `@source` pointed at the faces' own directory.
//: THE SPACES TENANT — olai's judgement ABOUT Xyne Spaces, phase 1 Mirror: doorbell digests and trimmed orchestrator replies posted outbound, agentProgress during turns, watch-only. There is no appliance-client package: Spaces is reached over HTTP with an app JWT, and that dial lives here.
//dependencies: `@olai/format` because `config.ts` reads `xyne-channel` and `agent-session` off the set. `solid-js` because this package owns the chrome pill. `effect` because the link cell is declared in Schema and its connector is an Effect. `@olai/plugin-api` because `./server` is a Cordis plugin and its `needs` name the services declared there — the INTERFACE, which names no plugin, where `@olai/bundle` is the REGISTRY and importing that back would be the cycle the manifests cannot express. No `@olai/web`: the pill's geometry arrives as a VALUE. No `@olai/state`: its mirror snapshot enters through the `LocalState` service, so this tenant does not become the sole reacher of the state leaf.
